learnings.claim: Official Gumroad docs (fetched 2026-10-10) state POST /v2/products requires the edit_products or account scope and publishes immediately unless draft=true or published=false; if publishing is blocked the product is saved as a draft with a warning field; GET /v2/products lists products (sales_count only with view_sales/account) and PUT /v2/products/:id/enable publishes. A personal access token is generated from an application in Gumroad advanced settings and does not expire until revoked.
learnings.decision: Request the narrowest scope that works (edit_products for draft create/read; add view_sales only if sales counts are needed). Always send draft=true, then read back with GET /v2/products/:id and require published=false before reporting success; treat a warning field as informational, not as published. Store the token as a secret and plan manual revocation since it never expires.
learnings.next_measurement: With an authorized token, create one draft product, read it back, and record published=false plus any warning text.
learnings.title: Gumroad draft create requires edit_products token and draft=true

learnings.claim: YouTube Help (fetched 2026-10-10) defines Stayed to watch as the percentage of times viewers stayed past the initial seconds of a Short (vs swiped away), Engaged views as views past the initial seconds excluding loops, and Average view duration / Average percentage viewed as calculated only from engaged views; since 2026-08-24 Views count at play start. The YouTube Analytics API exposes audienceWatchRatio and relativeRetentionPerformance by elapsedVideoTimeRatio, and the key-moments retention report needs videos of at least 60 seconds and 100 views.
learnings.decision: For Shorts, read Stayed to watch first (hook quality), then AVD/APV as retention among engaged viewers only; never compare Shorts AVD to long-form or to raw Views. Do not expect key-moments (intro/dips/spikes) for Shorts under 60 seconds or under 100 views; use audienceWatchRatio curves from the API instead when authorized.
learnings.next_measurement: Pull Stayed to watch, engaged views and AVD for the last 10 Shorts and record which ones fall below the channel median stayed-to-watch.
learnings.title: Shorts retention: stayed-to-watch is the gate, AVD is computed on engaged views
